data.name: HerboVest
data.detailed_description:
Hello, young Herbologist!

Congratulations on completing your studies at the School of Herbology!
Now it’s time to apply what you’ve learned and transform an abandoned plot of land into a thriving ecosystem.

In HerboVest, you play as an apprentice herbologist tasked with restoring a degraded area through careful cultivation, soil management, and ecological study.

Prepare the land, plant seeds, observe the growth of each species, and discover more efficient ways to care for your crops. As you progress, you’ll unlock new tools, research areas, and resources that expand your abilities as a field researcher.

What you can do in the game:

  • Plant and maintain: grow a wide variety of plants and keep your soil healthy and fertile.

  • Explore and collect: search for new seed types, minerals, and natural resources across different regions.

  • Study and progress: complete chapters from your Field Study Books to earn rewards and unlock new content.

  • Manage and expand: organize your plots, plan your cultivation strategy, and upgrade your greenhouse facilities.

  • Control infestations: protect your crops by managing pests and maintaining environmental balance.

  • Evolve as a researcher: improve your tools, develop new techniques, and become a certified master herbologist.

With a calm atmosphere and a focus on observation and experimentation, HerboVest offers a relaxing simulation experience for those who enjoy growth, strategy, and the quiet rhythm of nature.

Your ultimate goal: earn the Master Herbologist Certification and prove that patience and knowledge can bring life back to the land.

data.short_description: Cultive sementes vivas e crie criaturas híbridas numa fazenda 3D cheia de segredos, combate e humor. HerboVest mistura simulação agrícola e fantasia: plante, lute, colha e descubra que cada planta pode esconder muito mais do que parece.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 ou equivalente
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 ou equivalente
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatível com DirectX
  • Additional Notes: Jogo 3D com estilo visual leve, mas com mecânicas complexas de fazenda, coleta e combate. Requer hardware básico moderno.
